    FROM card c

    SELECT a.XCL_001 AS account_id
    FROM account a
    JOIN district dist ON a.XCL_002 = dist.XCL_017
    WHERE dist.XCL_020 = 'North Bohemia'
),

),

    SELECT

        t.XCL_055 AS amount

    JOIN target_accounts ta ON t.XCL_047 = ta.account_id
    WHERE t.XCL_053 = 'credit card'
      AND t.XCL_054 = 'withdrawal'
      AND strftime('%Y', t.XCL_048) IN ('1997', '1998')
),
yearly_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        year,
        SUM(amount) AS total_amount
    FROM credit_card_withdrawals
    GROUP BY year
)

JOIN yearly_totals yt1998 ON yt1998.year = '1998'
